1.text: “What if I forget?” Averi asked, imagining the big school stage. Her dance was only three days away, and her tummy felt full of butterflies.

2.text: Yuna was sitting under a tree with a notebook. “Stories have beginnings, middles, and endings,” she said. “Maybe your dance does too.”

3.text: They drew three chalk stars on the sidewalk. Averi stood on the first and took a breath.

4.text: On the second star she practiced her trickiest turn. She wobbled the first time, then spun all the way around. On the third, she held her final pose.

5.text: The next day the stage still looked big. But Averi remembered the three stars (beginning, middle, ending) and took her first step.

7.text: What Averi learned She had not waited until she felt completely unafraid. She had danced while feeling nervous, and that was what made her brave.

8.text: The End What will you create next?
